item.title: Data shows slight increase in abortions in 2025
item.description: Today, the Guttmacher Institute released abortion estimates for the year 2025. The news is not particularly good for pro-lifers. Overall, the Guttmacher Institute found that 1,126,000 abortions were performed in 2025. This represents a very slight increase of less than two-tenths of 1 percent since 2024. item.title: Judge orders Trump admin to bring back DACA recipient deported to Mexico
item.description: A federal judge has ordered the Trump administration to bring back a woman abruptly deported to Mexico last month despite her active protections under the Obama-era Deferred Action for Childhood Arrivals program.
